minimal_source_proposal.substitution: ONLY ep_start !(|(blk)) becomes !(parameter ? blk_nonempty_q : |blk). Retain every other blk consumer, blk_n, all bank-indexed gates, all timer/grant/queue decisions.
minimal_source_proposal.capture_every_service_edge: No desc/slot/queue-valid capture enable; asynchronous reset to 0 alongside blk. Warm reset must clear both even while prior debt existed; reset cannot invent publication/ACK.
exact_next32: If PI and ref_c==LEAD: !ep && !(pin!=0 && !pi_idle) sets onehot(bsel); otherwise HOLD.
Else if PI and ep_start: SET onehot(bsel).
Else if PI and ep && OR(blk&open): CLEAR.
Finally accepted row_fire && c_op==REFPB overrides all earlier choices: CLEAR.
scalar_mirror_proposal: Apply the SAME ordered branches above: each onehot SET assigns q_next=1, each CLEAR assigns q_next=0, HOLD keeps q.
Last accepted REFPB CLEAR wins, same as actual nonblocking assignment priority.
bsel is 5 bits, so 32b1<<bsel is always nonzero for driven initialized binary state.
Register q_next on EVERY service edge with async rst_n=0 -> q=0.
minimal_source_proposal.inductive_source_obligation: Base reset: q=OR(blk)=0. Assume q==OR(blk) before edge: ep_start replacement is equal; both take identical set/clear/hold branches and final REFPB override; each branch preserves equality. Queue push/pop, warm debt, grant/refusal, LEAD skip, pullin/cancellation and simultaneous events do not permit gated capture.
minimal_source_proposal.four_state_scope: No claimed 4-state equivalence; initialized/driven controls required; proposed defaultoff branch must preserve original source behavior.
minimal_source_proposal.minimum_new_connected_gate_if_selected: Extend existing slot invariant lockstep only with q==OR(blk) after every edge and exact original/defaultoff/on ep_start/output/debt equality; exercise held refresh, LEAD skip, cancellation, accepted REFPB overriding simultaneous set, accepted push/pop, empty/full and warm-reset. No global engine campaign.
minimal_source_proposal.not_proposed: Do not register ep_start itself, modify timer/eligibility/calendar, or replace blk with the predicate.
